sentence: Wehewehe.org, which hosts the Pukui & Elbert Hawaiian Dictionary, the same standard reference cited for [mahalo](/mahalo-meaning/), defines ʻohana plainly: "family, relative, kin group; related." The entry also lists two compounds, ʻohana holoʻokoʻa and ʻohana nui, both used for an extended family or clan rather than an immediate household.
note: Independent review: full source and original target body/all FAQ read. Narrow comparison supported by target quotation: The Pukui & Elbert Hawaiian Dictionary, compiled by Mary Kawena Pukui and Samuel H. Elbert
